description: Landed cost end to end (LOG-01/05/06/10): the packaging purchase order PO5447, whose Portal lines are $0.000, opened the way every case opens over a host cycle (scripts/eval_packaging_oracle_check.py landed-cost: operating.host captures the purchase-order Portal relations and the AGENTS site's '/Ontology UseCases' containers, GET only; operating.case_workspace_live opens petra_po=PO5447 offline), then plx.investigate landed_cost on the case's root as staff:operations together with the check's own verifier principal svc:landed-cost-verifier, the one principal the check's host config grants the finance marking (marking_grants; no employee principal holds it, docs/decisions/2026-10-18-landed-cost-host-money-and-page-size.md), so the cited money is read without widening any employee's access, every page, graded by the independent oracle evals/oracle/landed_cost.py against the pinned rows of examples/case_originals.json: the proforma invoice member co-707cc1b0ead2 and the forwarder quote members co-fce402cf438c (40HQ, destination charges) and co-b748fae544b6 (air, all-in) of the use-case zip co-8fabde0ade07. Every cited supplier-confirmation and quote value must resolve, as that reader, to bytes whose SHA-256 is a pinned row (the member re-read from the container's captured bytes, never the digest the citation states); each quote's assessment must carry a scope or exclusion code; the goods must equal one confirmed amount, or be unknown with a PI_VERSION_UNRESOLVED conflict listing every differing amount (never a picked version), or unknown for a typed engine reason the goods entry names (e.g. confirmation_currency_differs: the check is blocked on that code and oracle_check.missing names the value a person must supply); the total must be unknown while the duty-source gap stands. Any other answer fails (oracle_check.reasons). A pinned quote or proforma invoice no answer entry cites is the typed case.missing code quote_not_linked_to_po (a person must link the forwarder quote to the purchase order it prices) or pi_not_linked_to_po (a person must link the proforma invoice to the purchase order it confirms): the command exits 0 and the check is blocked (blocked_when) with cause source_gap, never a pass; oracle_check.missing names each pin and the value it needs.
notes: Live-unverified until the live check runs it. Module test is injected-transport: verify/tests/test_live_verify_landed_cost.py runs this spec's own command in-process over a FakeWorkbench (the packaging fixture, lines at $0.000) and an injected Graph transport serving a SYNTHETIC zip in the AGENTS '/Ontology UseCases' folder with a synthetic registry pinning its members, then replays the report through verify live_verify run_spec: pass; fail when a cited member's bytes differ from its pin; blocked (quote_not_linked_to_po) when a quote names no purchase order.
